verdict.rationale: Rive's State Machines and interaction docs (rive-docs-4, rive-docs-22, rive-docs-24) support building input-driven, trigger/transition-based interactivity without code, and rive-docs-16/23 frame the tool as skipping separate 'prototype' handoff entirely. However there is no evidence of a Figma-style multi-screen/overlay prototyping paradigm (linking distinct screens, overlay layers, click-through flows across artboards) — Rive's interactivity is scoped to state machines within/across components rather than an explicit screen-flow prototyping mode. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-screen linking, overlay/modal wiring, and click-through flow prototyping across separate artboards/screens.
